product_launches.description: Sixty60, developed by ShopriteX, launched Pixie, a personalised AI shopping assistant with a Smart Basket interface on the Sixty60 app in South Africa, initially in beta for Xtra Savings Plus members from 9 April 2026.

overview_description.description:
Sixty is the first freelance market network. Our goal is to transform career freelancing from a pipe dream to a sustainable and fulfilling reality. For clients, we want to accelerate hiring from taking weeks to find someone you barely trust to connecting with the best person in the world the same day for any job.

See the products powering our pilot economy at www.usesixty.com
